title: Plant Manager
text:
The Plant Manager provides overall leadership and direction for ABI's manufacturing, assembly operations, warehouse and inventory management, ensuring safe, efficient production, consistent product quality, on-time delivery, effective use of resources, and a positive, accountable workplace culture.

**Basic Function****:**

 

Plan, organize, and direct daily plant and warehouse operations while leading people, managing performance, maintaining safety and quality standards, and driving continuous improvement to meet company production and business objectives.

**Activities & Responsibilities****:**

**Operations & Production**

* Plan, organize, and direct all manufacturing and assembly operations to meet production schedules and quality targets.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including throughput, downtime, and waste, and take action to improve results.
* Coordinate with supply chain and logistics to ensure material availability and on-time delivery.
* Manage production capacity planning and equipment utilization.

 

**Warehouse & Inventory Management**

* Develop, Lead and Direct warehouse team members to achieve daily, weekly, monthly goals.
* Organize daily/weekly tasks to meet on time shipping, receiving, and inventory accuracy targets.
* Develop and maintain component and finished goods inventory storage strategy.
* Understand and utilize warehouse management system capabilities; train team members as needed to improve team performance.
* Proactively identify and implement cost savings and cost avoidance opportunities; drive continuous improvement mindset throughout the organization.
* Implement and improve internal processes and procedures (SOP) to drive efficiency and accuracy.
* Prepare product for shipment to minimize damage and improve shipping cost.

 

**Safety & Compliance**

 

* Champion a culture of safety by enforcing OSHA regulations and company safety policies.
* Lead incident investigations and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental, health, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular safety audits and coordinate required employee safety training.

 

**Quality & Continuous Improvement**

 

* Oversee quality control systems and ensure products meet specifications and customer expectations.
* Partner with other teams to resolve non-conformances and implement preventive measures.
* Drive continuous improvement using Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, or similar methodologies.

 

**People Management**

 

* Lead, develop, and retain managers and production and warehouse staff.
* Oversee hiring, performance management, and disciplinary processes.
* Foster a positive, accountable, high-performance work environment.

* Conduct regular team meetings, one on one meetings and clearly communicate objectives.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members on a timely basis.

 

**Financial Management**

 

* Identify and execute cost-reduction and operational-efficiency improvement projects.

 

**Skills & Qualifications:**

 

* Proven ability to lead teams in a fast-paced manufacturing, production and/or warehouse environment.
* Knowledge of Lean manufacturing, 5S, and continuous improvement tools.
* Experience with ERP/MRP/WMS systems, such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to monitor operational performance, identify issues, and drive results.
* Must be self-motivated as well as able and willing to work independently and in a team environment.
* Strong accountability and follow-through skills.
* Affinity for and/or experience with agriculture, sports turf, and property management industries, along with equipment operation.
* Must have unwavering integrity and positivity.
* Must be emotionally intelligent, a humble contributor to group goals and company needs.
* Must be a self-motivated and driven learner with a desire to grow and be developed.
* Must be willing to participate in ongoing education.

 

**Education & Experience:**

* GED, Diploma, Degree or Equivalent
* 7+ years of manufacturing experience, including 3+ years in a plant or operations management role and 3+ years experience in warehouse leadership and inventory management role.

 

**Physical Requirements:**

 

* Must have the ability to safely lift 50 pounds.
* Must be willing to work full-time, in-house.
* Must be able to stand, sit, and view a computer screen for the duration of a work shift.
* Must be legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States.
* Ability to talk or hear to communicate with others via phone, in-person, and/or computer.
* Ability to listen to customers/vendors/colleagues, problem solve and respond accordingly.
* Ability to read, write, and speak English fluently.

 

**Environmental Conditions & Travel****:**

 

* The employee is exposed to an office environment with moderate noise as well as warehouse and manufacturing environments with moderate noise.
* The employee is required to wear suitable Personal Protective Equipment while working in the warehouse or manufacturing environments.
* Travel: Less than 5%

 

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by persons assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all associated responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions.
